summary: AC Immune SA filed a Form 6-K on 2026-09-23 disclosing a press release with positive week-100 safety and immunogenicity results from Part 1 of VacSYn, a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial of ACI-7104 in 34 early-stage Parkinson's disease patients (25 active, nine placebo). All primary endpoints were met; 100% seroconversion after three immunizations, CSF antibody penetration and exploratory target-engagement signals. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor or structural mechanics are stated. The filing is a clinical trial update, not a special situation. Watch FDA Part 2 design meetings expected early 2027 and any partnering or financing implications.
